name: ActionReadout
label: Action readout
description: What a confirmed change did: a headline over a list of facts, worked out from the records as they were just before it.

props.name: headline
props.description: What was done, with how much: "69 orders cancelled".

props.name: facts
props.description: What it did, a line each: the status it moved, the money it touched, who it reached.

props.name: icon
props.description: A leading mark beside the headline: a Material Symbol name, or your own element.
